responsibility: Defines the GCC option table entries shared by Cygwin and MinGW x86 targets. Rather than implementing behavior itself, this .opt file declares the target and driver switches that feed the option machinery and target flags, including subsystem and DLL selection, PE aligned commons, MinGW thread support, writable relocated rdata, Cygwin libstdc++ wrapper control, and the executable-stack policy flag used for nested functions on these Windows targets.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cygming.h, this file is only the shared Cygwin/MinGW option-definition table, listing switches such as mconsole/mdll/mthreads and related flags; it does not define target ABI or assembler macros.
